messages:
elaine: deploy-bot blocked publish for image `quay.redwood/inference/runtime:2026-03-20-rc4` — logs say attestation time < manifest time, TTL enforced. anyone seen this before?

deploy-bot: publish blocked: provenance.attestation_time (2026-03-20T14:02:11Z) < image.manifest_time (2026-03-20T14:02:15Z). Policy: attestation-ttl=30s. run: https://ci.redwood-infra/job/9876/console

mike: yikes. that looks like a clock skew or delayed attestor. which builder pool pushed the image?

elaine: pushed from `ken-builders-us-west-2a`. i can repro manifest timestamps locally: `docker manifest inspect quay.redwood/inference/runtime:2026-03-20-rc4` then curl the registry manifest. logs show manifest time slightly ahead of attestation.

sam: tagging in. checking NTP and signer queue. also grep-ing attestor logs for lag. cc @jena

jena: if attestor delayed, we could either (a) retag & repush after fixing clocks, or (b) force-attest older manifest (risky). prefer rebake+repush to preserve provenance.

mike: rebake is fine but we need to pin digest in the release notes and call out the retag. release window is 14:30-15:30 UTC — we shouldn't rush without coordination.

elaine: i'll hold the release. plan: fix builder clock → rebake → repush as `:rc4-1` → run attestation. question: can deploy-bot be temporarily overridden for emergency publish?

oncall-bot: override path: `/deploybot override --ticket=REL-3421 --approvals=2` (requires eng-lead + infra). attach attestation artifact to PR. emergency bypass still records audit.

sam: spotted NTP drift on `ken-builders-us-west-2a` (0.7s). restarting chronyd, re-running attestation now. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: attestation created for manifest `sha256:abc123...` at 2026-03-20T14:03:04Z. policy check: OK. publish allowed.

mike: publishing now. i'll update release notes with digest + retag rationale.

elaine: publish completed, digest pinned to sha256:abc123... Release window unchanged. i'll add a changelog entry and a follow-up RFC to harden the pre-publish checks (clock, attestor latency).

sam: opened INF-1157 to add clock-monitoring + builder preflight gating. tracked in release board.

jena: good call. let's do a short blameless note in the release doc and add a unit test for attestor latency in CI. :thumbsup:

mike: thanks everyone — moving on to post-release checks.
